messages:
Mira (CSM): Heads up — AstraNova QBR next Tue. Need to align on token econ, spend forecast, and renewal risk. Anyone available for a quick sync today? Spreadsheet: https://redwood.app/sheets/astranova-qbr
Kevin (FinOps): I can own the spend forecast. Quick snapshot: last 30d token burn ~2.1B tokens (~$18.3k/mo). If growth +30% next month, ~2.7B tokens (~$23.8k). I'll paste a tiny table.
Kevin (FinOps): ```
period,tokens,cost
30d,2100000000,18300
30d+30%,2730000000,23800
commit-3mo-est,2400000000,21000
```
Olga (AE): FYI customer flagged budget constraints on last call — that's our biggest renewal risk. They rely heavily on embeddings for search personalization.
Ben (Platform Eng): I looked at sample traces — embedding calls have very low cache hit; session embeddings TTL set to 0. Suggest enabling prefix KV cache + small batching to cut token regen. In bench we saw ~18% cost down with minimal latency impact.
Mira (CSM): Can you post the exact config you'd recommend? Also we should schedule a 30-min enablement with their ML lead to walk tuning and cost controls.
Ben (Platform Eng): Example config snippet:```yaml
batch_size: 16
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_hours: 48
quantize: int8
```
Ben (Platform Eng): Lab notes: enabling prefix_kv + batch=16 -> token/sec slightly up, cost/unit down ~18%. Will attach raw numbers to the spreadsheet.
Kevin (FinOps): We should also set budget alerts on their account. Propose thresholds 70% / 90% / 100% of monthly budget; notify CSM, AE, and finance. Command I will run: `budget-bot create --acct astranova --thresholds 70,90,100 --notify mira,olga,kevin`
budget-bot: Budget alert created for AstraNova — thresholds 70%, 90%, 100%. Notifications: Mira, Olga, Kevin. First alert scheduled 7 days before month end.
Olga (AE): I'll prep a renewal playbook and schedule customer enablement Wed 11am PT — Mira can you send the calendar invites and add the ML lead?
Mira (CSM): On it. Also adding a short feedback ask: request top 3 heavy endpoints + any latency pain points so Ben can prioritize fixes. I'll add that to the spreadsheet and the invite.
Kevin (FinOps): For the QBR slides I can include 3 spend scenarios: baseline, +30% growth, and 6-mo commit discount. Quick note: a 6-month commit could reduce unit cost ~28% vs on-demand at their current profile. Want me to show dollars saved and payback?
Olga (AE): Yes — include the commit option and a simple recommendation (1) light enablement + config, (2) trial commit, (3) monitoring/alerts. That makes renewal decision easy.
Mira (CSM): Action items: - Kevin: spend scenarios + commit calc (due EOD) - Ben: config snippet + lab numbers into sheet (due EOD) - Olga: renewal playbook draft + invite - Mira: customer ask list + calendar invites
Kevin (FinOps): Ack :thumbsup:
Ben (Platform Eng): ack :rocket:
Olga (AE): ack :white_check_mark:
Mira (CSM): Thanks all. If we get the numbers early I can run a quick cost saving preview with them before the QBR.
Mira (CSM): Also note — I'll flag this in the QBR template under "risk: budget" so leadership is prepped.
Kevin (FinOps): I'll DM procurement about potential early-commit options and confirm discount tiers.
Ben (Platform Eng): If they need hands-on tuning I can join the enablement call.
Olga (AE): Perfect — closing loop after the invite is sent.
Mira (CSM): Closing here, will repost updates in the spreadsheet. Thanks team!
